checks.finding: The original v1 exact-key set and exact issued source remain; current source requires its separate schema with four exact commit/path/blob/raw fields.

replayOriginal official registrar/native replay is unchanged except returning its pre-write full-source UID layout; issued receipt, historical source binding, prerequisite/native authority equality and missing-binding restriction remain.

The request retains all original UIDs/ordinals, empty before/after, exact approval and refs. Selected whole-question objects are identical; current full source denominator, IDs/order and current identity layout remain exact.

Each selected referenced asset is freshly read at original-request, issued-receipt and current-source commits and live; all bytes and SHA values agree with the original replay authority. New batch verdict/cache is absent.
Registration and reuse check every cohort peer metadata/runtime/identity and invoke authority-hold state for all selected peers. Both valid and invalid hold claims refuse recovery.
Original receipt/source/assets are never output targets. Only new receipt/proof and carried metadata/runtime provenance are generated. Existing semantic fields and identity records are unchanged.

Current-source receipt/proof is reconstructed deterministically and full live cohort rechecked. Generic source-only descendants must preserve the complete cohort, exact predecessor digest, selected question/identity/approval values and original recovery replay.

Registrar, native runtime, Consumer and preview use existing strict explicit-recovery predicates; no broad legacy permission is added. Unknown/malformed current-source schema/ref fails typed validation.

Existing immutable original replay cache is not rewritten by transport. Returned request and transport evidence are cloned. Fresh current source, assets, refs, registry and cohort checks occur outside cached replay.

recommendedFocusedRegressions.case: Same original cohort and assets, distinct committed current source changing only outside rows: dry/write/replay/native all cohort pass; old receipt/source/assets byte-identical.
A later whole-cohort generic source-only preservation can replay the new transport receipt through the original authority.
Keep the v1 schema while using changed whole-source bytes; or use new schema with absent/extra/wrong current source ref; no write.
Mutate any selected whole-question field, including a field outside stored fingerprints; reject even when source/current ref is honestly resealed.
Missing/duplicate/reordered full-source IDs, changed full identity UID/ordinal/question-number layout, or denominator drift; no write.
Valid target row but another selected peer metadata/runtime/identity differs, or has an authority-hold seal/claim; reject whole cohort.
Selected same-path asset differs in any original/issued/current Git snapshot or fresh live bytes, including warm-cache call, missing file or symlink; no write.
Remove or alter new proof/schema/output-digest/evidence binding; existing no-fallback guards must continue to reject.
A later descendant preserves only a subset, splits revisions, changes a peer/identity, loses predecessor proof, or adds approval fields; reject.

limits: This review does not claim actual E064 dry/write/replay, Consumer, shadow or main success.
Final frozen commit must be bound to the reviewed module SHA or re-read if the bytes change.
